description: Get complete Markdown descriptions for one four-digit visa condition number. Returns every official source record for that number, source links and retrieval date. Do not select or merge variants. English is official source text; Chinese is translated. This is not a personal visa record or eligibility assessment.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

name: get_visa_condition
title: Get an Australian visa condition
